title: melica persica subsp. canescens
intro: Melica persica subsp. canescens, commonly known as Persian wild barley, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Melica persica subsp. canescens are believed to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit hepatoprotective and cardioprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
